_readme: Yahan apna app ka naam aur uska exact .exe path daalo - Ultron open_application() call karte waqt SABSE PEHLE yahan dekhega, phir Start Menu/registry/other detection try karega. Isliye jo bhi app yahan list hai, wo kabhi 'not found' nahi bolega. Key lowercase mein rakho (jaise 'obs', 'valorant', 'my project'). Value poora exe path hai, backslash ko double likhna hai (\\) ya forward slash (/) use karo. '_' se shuru hone wali koi bhi key (jaise ye readme) Ultron ignore kar deta hai. Naya app khud dhoondh ke bharwana ho to: python tools/scan_all_apps.py chalao - wo saari drives scan karke isi file mein add kar dega (jo already yahan hai use nahi chhedega).
head: C:\MinGW\msys\1.0\bin\head.exe
